details:
The MariaDB Native Client library (C driver) is used to connect applications developed in C/C++ to MariaDB and MySQL databases. 

Security Fix(es):

* mariadb: MariaDB server: SQL injection vulnerability via improper handling of big5 character set with mysql_real_escape_string() (CVE-2026-44172)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
